conditional.instruction: Choose the primary write when the first source returns at least two records; otherwise use the fallback write. Verify only the branch that ran.

deep_chain.instruction: Collect the evidence, project its record identifiers, remove duplicate identifiers, write the result, and read it back.

delete_chain.instruction: Write and read back the result, then delete that exact returned record and read it back to confirm it is gone.

diamond.instruction: Project record identifiers and titles independently, join both projections into the write, and verify it.

fan_in.instruction: Read all sources, collect their evidence, write one result, and read it back.

fan_out.instruction: Create two independently named outputs from the same collected evidence and verify both.

map_read.instruction: Search each source, fetch every matching record up to the declared bound, collect the records, write one result, and verify it.

read_chain.instruction: Read the sources in their listed order before collecting evidence, writing, and verifying.

write_chain.instruction: Write and read back the result, then update that exact returned record with its verification marker and read it back again.
